points.K3: 低温工况用低温专用阀

points.S3: 背压阀、安全阀不能堵、不乱调

shots.scene: 欣欣站在一排用链条固定的气瓶旁，瓶口装着带两块压力表的减压阀，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a row of gas cylinders chained to the wall, each fitted with a two-gauge pressure regulator, and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课讲减压阀和背压阀的安全使用。
overlay: 减压阀与背压阀的安全使用

shots.scene: 减压阀、背压阀、压力表、扳手打叉四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Four icons in a row: a pressure regulator, a back pressure valve, a blank pressure gauge, and a wrench crossed out. No people.
shots.narration: 选得对、开得稳、查得勤、不带压修。

shots.scene: 阿杰拿着一个减压阀，准备装到另一种颜色的气瓶上
shots.prompt_en: The young male student holds a regulator taken from one cylinder and tries to fit it onto a cylinder of a different color.
shots.narration: 阿杰图省事，想把减压阀换到别的气瓶上。

shots.scene: 不同颜色气瓶和同一个减压阀之间画问号
shots.prompt_en: An icon of one regulator between two cylinders of different colors with a big question mark. No people.
shots.narration: 气体不同，减压阀能通用吗？

shots.scene: 小研摇头，指向减压阀上的空白标签
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student shakes her head and points at a blank tag on the regulator.
shots.narration: 小研说：先看清它是给哪种气用的。

shots.section_title: 减压阀和背压阀做什么
shots.scene: 减压阀示意：高压箭头进、低压稳定箭头出
shots.prompt_en: A diagram of a pressure regulator: a thick high-pressure arrow goes in, a thin steady low-pressure arrow comes out. No people.
shots.narration: 减压阀把高压降下来，输出稳定的压力。
overlay: 减压阀和背压阀做什么

shots.section_title: 减压阀和背压阀做什么
shots.scene: 减压阀上的两块压力表：进口表和出口表
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a regulator with two blank gauges, one labeled by an up arrow icon and one by a down arrow icon. No people.
shots.narration: 一块表看瓶内压力，一块看输出压力。

shots.section_title: 减压阀和背压阀做什么
shots.scene: 背压阀示意：上游压力过高时阀门打开，多余气体排走
shots.prompt_en: A diagram of a back pressure valve: when upstream pressure rises too high, the valve opens and extra gas vents away. No people.
shots.narration: 背压阀守住上游，压力高了就放掉。

shots.scene: 小流量阀门接大管道，下游压力表指针乱晃
shots.prompt_en: A diagram of a small regulator feeding a large pipe, the downstream gauge needle wobbling. No people.
shots.narration: 流量不够，下游压力就会忽高忽低。

shots.scene: 老李对照空白表格选阀门
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer compares regulators against a blank specification sheet.
shots.narration: 按实际用气量选合适的减压阀。

shots.section_title: 低温工况用低温专用阀
shots.scene: 低温储罐上的调压阀结着霜
shots.prompt_en: A frosty regulator mounted on a cryogenic storage tank. No people.
shots.narration: 低温储罐上的调压阀，工况特殊。
overlay: 低温工况用低温专用阀

shots.section_title: 低温工况用低温专用阀
shots.scene: 普通阀门放在冰块上开裂的图标，打红叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of an ordinary valve sitting in ice with a crack line, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不能拿普通阀门代替低温阀。

shots.scene: 阀门剖面里的过滤网挡住小颗粒
shots.prompt_en: A cutaway of a regulator inlet with a fine mesh strainer blocking small dirt particles. No people.
shots.narration: 进口过滤网挡住杂质，保护阀芯。

shots.scene: 老李清洗过滤网，旁边压力表指针为零
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer cleans a small mesh strainer at a bench, a blank gauge beside him reading zero.
shots.narration: 过滤网要定期清洁，先泄压再拆。

shots.section_title: 口径和调节范围要匹配
shots.scene: 大小不同的阀门和几根不同粗细的弹簧图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of regulators in different sizes and several springs of different thickness. No people.
shots.narration: 口径、调节范围都要和用途匹配。
overlay: 口径和调节范围要匹配

shots.section_title: 口径和调节范围要匹配
shots.scene: 老李在空白图纸上打勾
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer checks off items on a blank drawing with a pen.
shots.narration: 选型交给专业人员确认。

shots.scene: 老周和阿杰核对空白采购单
shots.prompt_en: The older man and the young male student check a blank purchase form together.
shots.narration: 从正规渠道采购，有疑问问供应商。

shots.scene: 不同颜色气瓶各配一个专用减压阀，打绿勾
shots.prompt_en: Cylinders of different colors, each with its own dedicated regulator, with a green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 减压阀专瓶专用，不能乱换。

shots.scene: 氧气减压阀旁的油壶和沾油手套图标，打红叉
shots.prompt_en: An oxygen regulator icon next to an oil can and an oily glove, both crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 氧气减压阀严禁沾油脂。

shots.scene: 小研检查瓶口螺纹和密封垫
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student inspects the cylinder valve threads and a sealing washer before connecting a regulator.
shots.narration: 装之前，看清螺纹和密封垫完好。

shots.scene: 小研把减压阀调节手柄旋松
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student turns the regulator adjusting knob counterclockwise to loosen it.
shots.narration: 开瓶阀前，先把调节手柄旋松。

shots.scene: 小研站在气瓶侧面，慢慢打开瓶阀
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student stands to the side of the regulator and slowly opens the cylinder valve.
shots.narration: 人站侧面，慢慢打开瓶阀。

shots.scene: 小研慢慢旋紧手柄，看着出口压力表
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student slowly turns the adjusting knob while watching the outlet gauge.
shots.narration: 再慢慢调到需要的输出压力。

shots.scene: 关瓶阀、放空、松手柄三个步骤图标
shots.prompt_en: Three step icons: closing the cylinder valve, venting the line, loosening the regulator knob. No people.
shots.narration: 用完先关瓶阀，再放空，再松手柄。

shots.section_title: 背压阀、安全阀不能堵、不乱调
shots.scene: 背压阀和安全阀的排放口通向安全方向
shots.prompt_en: A back pressure valve and a safety relief valve with vent pipes leading to a safe outdoor area. No people.
shots.narration: 排放口要引到安全的地方。
overlay: 背压阀、安全阀不能堵、不乱调

shots.section_title: 背压阀、安全阀不能堵、不乱调
shots.scene: 安全阀被堵住、手柄被拧到底的图标，打红叉
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a relief valve plugged shut and an adjusting screw cranked all the way down, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不能堵排放口，不能随意调高设定。

shots.section_title: 背压阀、安全阀不能堵、不乱调
shots.scene: 老李按空白规程调整阀门
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer adjusts a back pressure valve while following a blank procedure sheet.
shots.narration: 调整由专业人员按规程进行。

shots.scene: 压力表上贴着空白检定标签
shots.prompt_en: A pressure gauge with a blank calibration sticker on its face. No people.
shots.narration: 压力表要在检定有效期内。

shots.scene: 指针卡住、接头漏气冒泡、阀体结霜三个异常图标
shots.prompt_en: Three warning icons: a stuck gauge needle, bubbles at a leaking joint, and unusual frost on a regulator body. No people.
shots.narration: 指针异常、漏气、调不动，立即停用。

shots.scene: 阀门挂上空白停用牌
shots.prompt_en: A regulator with a blank out-of-service tag hanging on it. No people.
shots.narration: 挂牌停用，报告检修。

shots.scene: 老李关闭瓶阀，压力表指针回零
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer closes the cylinder valve and watches both gauges drop to zero.
shots.narration: 拆减压阀前，先关气源、泄压。

shots.scene: 扳手拧带压减压阀的图标，打红叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a wrench loosening a regulator with gauge needles still high, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 压力管路不得带压拆卸。

shots.scene: 王老师在空白屏幕前讲解，屏幕上是气瓶和储罐图标
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator explains in front of a blank screen showing icons of a gas cylinder and a storage tank.
shots.narration: 气瓶和储罐都按特种设备规定管理。

shots.scene: 减压阀接口处冒出气流，小研关闭瓶阀
shots.prompt_en: Gas hisses from a regulator connection; the female graduate student quickly closes the cylinder valve.
shots.narration: 漏气时，能安全关阀就先关瓶阀。

shots.scene: 开窗通风，电灯开关和火焰打红叉
shots.prompt_en: Icons of an open window and fan, next to a light switch and a flame crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 通风，可燃气体不碰电器明火。

shots.scene: 小研向老周报告
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student reports to the older man in the corridor.
shots.narration: 撤离并报告实验室负责人。

shots.scene: 电话图标旁有火焰和红十字
shots.prompt_en: A telephone icon with a fire icon and a red cross icon beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 火情拨打119，有人受伤拨打120。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现减压阀、背压阀图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside floating icons of a pressure regulator and a back pressure valve.
shots.narration: 减压阀稳输出，背压阀防超压。

shots.scene: 专用标签、禁油、侧站三个打勾图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons with green checks: a dedicated regulator tag, a no-oil symbol, a person standing to the side. No people.
shots.narration: 专瓶专用，氧气禁油，侧身慢开。

shots.scene: 检定标签、停用牌、压力表回零图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a calibration sticker, an out-of-service tag and a gauge at zero. No people.
shots.narration: 表要有效，异常停用，泄压再修。

shots.scene: 欣欣在整齐的气瓶架前挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye in front of a tidy, chained cylinder rack with regulators.
shots.narration: 压力稳稳的，实验稳稳的，下次见！
